Ads are about to roll out on Apple Maps in the US and Canada, and businesses can start booking ads from today. Here are the details, including a limited-time business promotion offer.

Businesses can book Apple Maps ads starting today

If you own a business and want to advertise through Apple Maps, the booking service officially opens today.

Although users haven't yet seen the ads officially launch, Apple has already allowed businesses to start booking in preparation for the full rollout.

Complete ad booking information has been published on Apple's official website, including a detailed getting-started guide.

Apple has also launched a special limited-time offer, with details as follows:

This offer applies to eligible businesses that book map ads with credit card payment on or before October 11, 2026.

As mentioned earlier this year, ads will appear in two locations on Apple Maps:

  • Before users search: "Suggested locations" on the search screen will display business ads.
  • After users search: When search results are relevant to a business, ads will appear among the results.

If you're considering advertising through Apple Maps, the company also has a dedicated page explaining their advertising approach; please click here to browse.

Apple says there are over one billion business-related searches on Apple Maps every month, and one in every two business searches leads users to take action. Additionally, according to Q1 2025 GWI Core research, Gen Z and Millennials account for 57% of Apple Maps users.
